name: Brothers Coffee - Hole in the Wall (Outlet)
address: 105A Lang St, Bergsig, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Artisan coffee roastery and café serving expertly crafted brews in the heart of Groot Brak River.
description_long:
Tucked away on Lang Street in Bergsig, Brothers Coffee's Hole in the Wall outlet brings specialty coffee culture to Groot Brak River. This isn't just another coffee stop – it's where passionate roasters share their craft through carefully sourced beans and precise brewing methods. The compact space has a welcoming, unpretentious feel that invites you to linger over a proper cup.

Whether you're after a smooth flat white, a bold espresso, or beans to take home, the team here knows their coffee. The café also stocks quality coffee equipment and treats, making it a go-to for both daily caffeine fixes and stocking up on supplies. It's become a local favourite for good reason – consistent quality, friendly service, and coffee that's roasted with care.

Conveniently located just off the N2, it's an ideal pit stop for travellers heading along the Garden Route or locals popping in before work. The relaxed atmosphere and genuine love for coffee make it worth seeking out, even if it takes a moment to find the 'hole in the wall' entrance.
